title: Learning to Use Present and Past Tense Verbs

hint.text: Remember that past tense verbs describe something that has already happened, and present tense verbs describe something that is happening now, or happens often.
hint.label: Hint

instruction.text: Drag the verbs into the correct category. Select the verbs to hear them in a sentence.

atoms.sound: The cow jumped over the moon
I ran as fast as I could
I see my parents in the audience
We saw the film in the cinema
They walked all the way there
I always laugh at my dad
She laughed at the TV programme
I cook for my siblings every week
My mum cooked a tasty meal
We go to visit grandma once a year
